name: Melanesian (Anuta and Vanuatu)
description: Star lore of Anuta (Solomon Islands) and the Netwar (Vanuatu) people compiled for Stellarium.
source: Stellarium sky culture 'anutan' (https://github.com/Stellarium/stellarium/tree/master/skycultures/anutan); contributed by: This sky culture was contributed to Stellarium by *Dan Smale*, smaledanieloutlook.com

Stellarium sky culture 'vanuatu_netwar' (https://github.com/Stellarium/stellarium/tree/master/skycultures/vanuatu_netwar); contributed by: This sky culture was contributed by *Dominik M. Ramík*. Web: dominicweb.eu, e-mail: Elders from local communities on Tanna, who contributed with their ancestral knowledge to this project: Jimmy Napip from Ikumhala, Lomai Tain from Ielkes, Sylvano Kapalu from Ipai, Iawilu Naumusapen from Lowkweria, K
